name: Telegram Review
description: Telegram triage, drafting support, send support, bounded mark-read workflows, and narrow solicitation cleanup.

commands.name: /telegram
commands.description: Surface the Telegram triage queue into Signal without starting a Codex turn.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_TELEGRAM_PYTHON_BIN
requiredConfig.description: Optional Python executable override for Telegram CLI calls.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_TELEGRAM_AUTO_CLEANUP_SOLICITATIONS
requiredConfig.description: When true, bridge-side Telegram triage first runs narrow direct market-making/exchange-listing solicitation cleanup.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_TELEGRAM_AUTO_CLEANUP_LIMIT
requiredConfig.description: Optional dialog scan limit for bridge-side solicitation cleanup.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store session files, dialog snapshots, phone numbers, drafts, or message text in the plugin manifest.
